import type { ProductRepository } from '../../domain/repositories/ProductRepository';
import type { StockLevelDto } from './ProductDtos';
import { toStockLevelDto } from './ProductMapper';

export interface ListStockLevels {
  execute(): StockLevelDto[];
}

export class ListStockLevelsUseCase implements ListStockLevels {
  constructor(private readonly products: ProductRepository) {}

  execute(): StockLevelDto[] {
    return this.products.findAll().map(toStockLevelDto);
  }
}

=====SOURCE-END=====
